ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a 2 V voltage source, with the positive terminal on top and the negative terminal on the bottom. The middle branch has a resistor R1 = 2 kΩ, connecting the left upper node and the right node. The right vertical branch has a resistor R2 = 6 kΩ, with the current i2 marked beside it as downward. There is also a diode above, connected in parallel with R1 between the left and right upper nodes. Reasoning: According to the specified method, first assume the diode is cut off. In this way, current can only go from the 2 V voltage source through R1 = 2 kΩ, then through R2 = 6 kΩ and return to the negative terminal of the source, so R1 and R2 are in series. The series current is I = 2 V / (2 kΩ + 6 kΩ) = 2/8000 A = 0.25 mA. This series current is also the magnitude of the current i2 through R2. Then check whether the diode cutoff assumption is consistent: the voltage across R1 is I R1 = 0.25 mA × 2 kΩ = 0.5 V, which is less than the diode conduction voltage 0.7 V, so the diode will not conduct, and the cutoff assumption is valid. Therefore |i2| = 0.25 mA.

method.method_draft: Assume instead that the diode is on. The left upper node is at +2 V relative to the bottom node, so the on diode would force the right node to 2 V − 0.7 V = 1.3 V. Then R2 current would be i2 = 1.3 V / 6 kΩ ≈ 0.217 mA downward. The R1 current from left to right would be 0.7 V / 2 kΩ = 0.35 mA. At the right node, R1 alone would deliver more current than R2 can carry, so the diode current would have to be negative/opposite to the assumed forward direction. Thus the diode-on assumption is inconsistent. With the diode off, solve the remaining R1–R2 series circuit: i2 = 2 V/(2 kΩ + 6 kΩ) = 0.25 mA.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路图中，左侧有一个 2 V 电压源，其上端为正、下端为负；下方导线作为参考底部节点。左上节点通过 R1=2 kΩ 连接到右侧节点，右侧节点再通过 R2=6 kΩ 连接到底部节点，i2 标注为流过 R2 向下的电流。图中上方还有一个二极管与 R1 并联，方向为从左上节点指向右侧节点，二极管导通压降给定为 0.7 V。推理：按指定方法先假设二极管导通。左上节点相对底部节点为 +2 V，因此若二极管导通，右侧节点电压会被钳位为 2 V - 0.7 V = 1.3 V。此时 R2 上的向下电流为 i2 = 1.3 V / 6 kΩ ≈ 0.217 mA。R1 从左到右的电流为 (2 V - 1.3 V) / 2 kΩ = 0.35 mA。右侧节点处，仅 R1 送入的 0.35 mA 就已经大于 R2 能流走的约 0.217 mA，因此二极管电流必须为负，即与假设的正向导通方向相反，所以二极管导通假设不成立。于是二极管截止，剩余电路为 R1 和 R2 串联接在 2 V 电源上。串联电流即 R2 中的电流：i2 = 2 V / (2 kΩ + 6 kΩ) = 2 / 8000 A = 0.25 mA。因此 i2 的 magnitude 为 0.25 mA。
